lead: Off-the-shelf tools are designed for many businesses at once. If you work differently, you can build an application around your own processes — with the features and views your team actually needs.

sections.heading: Your process shapes the application
sections.text: You do not have to change a proven way of working because a standard system cannot accommodate it. Together, we define what the application should make easier, who will use it and what information needs to be at hand. I design around those needs, without features that get in the way of everyday use.

sections.heading: One tool your business needs
sections.text: An application can organise requests, improve the flow of information, bring data together or support a specific stage of customer service. We agree on the scope based on real tasks and your budget, and the solution can grow as your business needs change.

sections.heading: Web, iOS and Android
sections.text: I build web applications that run in a browser and mobile applications for iOS and Android. We choose the format to suit where and how people work — at a desk, in the field or both. The goal is a tool that fits naturally into their working day.
